decisions.reviewer: Codex root actual catalog five-view inspection

front.note: Mint open tub now has smoothly rounded molded corners.

rear.note: Rear walls curve continuously into the short ends and attached handles.

detail.note: Rolled lip and paired lower ribs remain separate without broad corner facets.

underside.note: Closed base follows the rounded tub perimeter and retained reinforcing ribs.

clay.note: Smooth tapered walls retain the original flexible-basket silhouette.

decisions.reviewer: Codex root actual catalog five-view inspection

front.note: Two blue cloth sacks hang inside the unchanged timber frame with subtle inward folds.

rear.note: Rear sack panels have restrained bowing beneath the suspension loops.

detail.note: Fine seams follow the actual bag surfaces instead of crossing rigid flat panels.

underside.note: Closed nested sack floors remain above the lower wooden rails.

clay.note: Soft hanging sides and separate timber frame now have distinct construction.

decisions.reviewer: Codex root actual catalog five-view inspection

front.note: Flexible hose follows a smooth hanging curve from base to head.

rear.note: Rear view confirms both hose attachments remain seated beside the telescopic pole.

detail.note: Reinforcing rings follow the curved hose without capped overlapping ends.

underside.note: Wheeled base and hose inlet remain attached inside the original footprint.

clay.note: Curved hose removes the angular elbow breaks while preserving the tall steamer stance.

front.note: Smoothed blue tank and white shoulder retain a pointed iron profile.

rear.note: Handle heel now enters the tank and its flexible cord relief joins the heel.

detail.note: Rounded handle corners meet the casing beside the retained buttons and dial.

underside.note: Metal soleplate retains the separate modeled steam perforations.

clay.note: Continuous molded housing and seated handle replace the faceted disconnected construction.

decisions.reviewer: Codex root actual catalog five-view inspection

front.note: Channel-back chair now has a continuous fine perimeter seat seam.

rear.note: Original rear shell and metal arm supports remain connected.

detail.note: Seat welt follows the cushion without the previous buried and floating breaks.

underside.note: Five-star caster base and under-seat controls are unchanged and supported.

clay.note: Seated piping improves the padded seat while retaining the chair silhouette.

rear.note: Rear shade and bound rim show no broad radial corners.

underside.note: Closed diffuser remains seated inside the lower circular hem.
